notes.title: Beta 0.25 released
notes.content:
[list]
[*] There's now an "unlock all" option on the menu that unlocks everything, skips the tutorial, etc.

[*] Speaking of tutorial - it's had a lot of work done recently. Please let us know what you think!

[*] You can now customize your helicopter by landing on your shed roof, or at a landing pad at a gas station

[*]  Medevac, taxi missions, and delivery missions are all available and working pretty well

[*] There are photography badges to earn, as well as several racing badges
[/list]

As always, please join our [url=http://https//discord.gg/ZyPqju]Discord [/url]to give us feedback!

notes.title: Beta Builds 0.1: Fires and more
notes.content:
0.1 PATCH NOTES:

- Improved fire system - fires spread more realistically, and randomly start. The game will also show you where the fires are.
- Improved delivery missions
- Improved character interactions
- Improved UI and made characters a bit more interactive
- Less annoying music :)

COMING SOON:
- More fire-fighting improvements
- Progress saving
- Helicopter customization and progression
